title: Why am I getting a FileNotFoundError when trying to create a SparkContext?
question:
I am currently on Python: 3.7.9, spark: spark-3.1.2-bin-hadoop3.2

In this project venv, I have the settings as:

kafka-python 2.0.2
pip 21.2.4
py4j 0.10.9
pyspark 2.4.6
setuptools 57.4.0

PYTHONPATH         %SPARK_HOME%\python;%SPARK_HOME%\python\lib\py4j-0.10.9-src.zip;%PYTHONPATH%
PATH               %SPARK_HOME%\bin;%SPARK_HOME%\python;%PATH%

I am trying to execute following code in Python:

import sys
from pyspark import SparkContext, SparkConf
from pyspark.streaming import StreamingContext

if __name__ == "__main__":

In case it's required: my dir structure is: C:\spark-3.1.2-bin-hadoop3.2\spark\python...
answer:
According to the information provided, you've installed pyspark separately from your Spark installation, which means you're going to have version issues

You should run Spark submit / pyspark shell directly from your Spark folder to ensure its the same versions.

Similarly download the correct spark-sql-kafka-0-10 version jar for your code
